title: Loaded word at a natural address
statement: For every natural word width $W$, list of integers $ws$, and natural address $a$, the memory obtained by loading $ws$ at address $a$ contains at that address the $W$-bit representation of the $a$th list entry, using zero when the list has no such entry.
